s1.syndrome_frame: A chronic, slowly progressive lump with associated pain and discomfort at the posterior aspect of the knee joint
salient_findings: A 3-year history of a lump on the posterior aspect of the right knee joint
Pain and discomfort while walking or standing with the knee joint extended
A 3 x 3 cm sized palpable lump at the posterior aspect of the right knee joint
key_facts: The patient is a 53-year-old woman
The patient has no underlying diseases
The lump is located at the posterior aspect of the right knee joint
The patient experiences pain and discomfort while walking or standing with the knee joint extended
The range of right knee motion is 10-130°
There is no internal swelling of the knee joint
There is no tenderness of the medial or lateral joint line
The Lachman test results are normal
The valgus and varus stress tests are normal
A 3 x 3 cm sized palpable lump is present at the posterior aspect of the right knee joint
Radiographic findings show normal knee joint and lower limb alignments
Mild osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1) is present in both knee joints
MRI findings show a multi-lobulated cyst measuring 3.3 cm × 3.0 cm × 3.9 cm at the popliteal fossa
